issue_context.title: Radarr integration calendar entries a day out
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I use Radarr for movies and have setup the HASS Radarr calendar integration.

In radarr it will show movies with one date, whereas in HASS is shows the movies, but a day earlier.

If I run the linux date command in both my radarr and hass containers, it shows the correct time for each.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2024.2.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

radarr

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/radarr/

### Diagnostics information

GMT

Both containers have TZ set to Europe/London

* same behaviour here - all whole day events are displayed one day too early in home assistant calendar
* in my case calendars are synced via caldav integration from my synology nas
* exactly same issue as reported here: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/98892
* TZ is Europe/Berlin

update
* the behaviour occurs if and only if the event is a "recurring" whole day event
* reproduction steps
   * create a one time whole day event in the source calendar (in my case synology calendar)
   * home assistant calendar is displaying the event correctly
   * modify the event in the source calendar to be "weekly recurring"
   * home assistant calendar is displaying an additional duplicate event the day before
   * home assistant calendar is displaying the duplicated event with a weekly reoccurrence
* probably this issue is also related to the same root cause: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/110165
